one_liner: Otter.ai has an Enterprise-only public REST API with bearer API keys, plus an official OAuth MCP server (mcp.otter.ai) that is read-only and available on all tiers.
auth_notes: Public API uses bearer API keys created at Integrations → Developer (max 2 per user). The MCP server uses OAuth, but no public OAuth client registration for third-party apps is documented. The connect.tryotter.com OAuth docs belong to a different product (Otter restaurant platform), so I did not count them.
access_notes: The public API is available only on Enterprise workspaces, which require contacting sales or an account manager. Enterprise has a 100-user minimum and custom contracts. The free Basic plan has no API access.
blocker_notes: The REST API requires an Enterprise plan and enablement by an account manager. The official MCP server is a possible alternative path. It is read-only, with only three tools (user info, search, fetch transcript), and the docs say there is no public API key for it.
